name: Kitchens By Creative Woodworking, Inc.

niche_evidence.quote: Contact Brandon Oren: Expert Kitchen Remodeling in East Central Indiana

niche_notes: Contact page title quoted. Home page title is the Wix default 'Home | My Site' with no H1; the heading on every page is 'Kitchens By Creative Woodworking, Inc.', which leads with kitchens. About page: 'completed over 150 complete kitchens from start to finish. Brandon does not subcontract his work.' Other services listed: custom cabinets, refacing, bathrooms, laundry rooms, mudrooms. Installs its own work, so not a cabinet seller. Passed NICHE.
g4_notes: Only auto signal is google_review (not re-checked per instructions). Second, different type searched: (1) site_dated_content: Wix site has only Home, About, Contact; /blog and /blog-feed.xml return 404; sitemap lastmod alone does not count. (2) job_posting: /careers 404; WebSearch for the company and Brandon Oren with hiring terms found nothing. (3) social_post: site links no social account (Facebook is named in text only, login-walled, not read); WebSearch found no YouTube, Pinterest or LinkedIn account. (4) permit: no open-data permit portal found for Parker City, Muncie or Delaware County IN; ArcGIS Hub search returned none for the area. (5) licence_renewal: Indiana has no state contractor licence; Delaware County contractor registration renews by 31 December, outside the window. No second type dated 2026-07-16..2026-10-14. Stopped at G4.
g3_notes: Wix free-plan site ('Upgrade Required' banner); footer shows only 'BACK TO TOP', no vendor credit.

socials.note: named in contact page text as '@kitchenofyourdreamskbcwi', not linked

assessment: Opinion: a genuine owner-operated kitchen remodeller with a bare Wix free-plan site, but no second dated activity type could be evidenced.
inference_rejected: The Facebook handle in text was not opened (login wall); no activity is claimed from it. Decision maker and email recorded from the contact page already fetched; G5 and G6 not formally run because G4 failed.
could_not_check: Facebook page; city/county permit records for Muncie and Delaware County (no open-data portal found).
